mostWorthwhile.text: Building the two sensor types was worthwhile because the pictures showed how fluid lag and shifting weights bend the sensory hairs in different situations.

leastWorthwhile.text: The repeated attempts to connect the balance organs were confusing: the pictures suggested a connection, but the required assembly order was not clear.

surprise.text: I expected to connect the turning sensors to the nerves first, but compatibility feedback joined the two sensor types instead.

arbitrary.text: Connecting the response routes to the body before adding the balance organs felt like an unclear prerequisite. The later picture made the order easier to follow, but I needed a hint.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter: seeing how the sensors help keep the eyes steady was interesting, though I hope the next assembly order is clearer.
